messages:
Lena: Quick sync — finalizing the competitive battlecard scripts for the webinar next week and the inbound routing play. Need sharp one-liners vs cloud vendors + a fallback routing rule for high-intent leads.

Kai: Got it. I pushed an updated table of competitor claims to the drive (see thread). Can we trim to 3 core contrasts? ops/cost/reliability?

Priya: Yes 3 is good. Suggest: 1) predictable cost controls (batching/quantization), 2) unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private, 3) built-in fallbacks for reliability. Short, punchy.

Ben: For the webinar slide deck I like: "Predictable inference economics — not just lower price-per-token". Keeps it non-technical but impactful.

Marta: Sales POV: need a quick routing script for inbound leads. If prospect mentions <security> or <private>, route to AE enterprise. If the prospect is startups/PLG, route to SDRs. Can we embed intent thresholds?

Lena: Exactly — here's a minimal example we can hand to ops to implement (feel free to simplify):
```
# inbound routing pseudo
if lead.text contains any(["on-prem","VPC","private"]) or lead.tags includes "security":
    route = "ae-enterprise"
elif lead.company_size < 50 or lead.tags includes "plg":
    route = "sdr-plg"
elif lead.intent_score >= 0.7:
    route = "ae-high-intent"
else:
    route = "sdr-general"
```

Priya: Love the pseudo. Add one more: if model-specific benchmarking request present ("latency","throughput","quantization"), route to solutions-eng for benchmark pack.

Lena: Good call — add: `if lead.tags includes "benchmark": route = "solutions-eng"`

Kai: On messaging — recommend two quick soundbites for slides + chat opens: 1) "Same API everywhere: hosted + dedicated + private" 2) "Fallbacks keep your app online when capacity matters". Both contrast vs managed endpoints that are single-mode.

Marta: For field scripts, can we give reps 3 rebuttals against "cloud vendor scale" claim? Example: "Scale isn't the only lever — serving economics + routing policies matter for predictable unit costs". Short and practiceable.

Ben: I'll craft 30s ad copy and 90s opener for the webinar using those lines. Sharing by EOD. :thumbsup:

leadgen-bot: New inbound example captured from signup form — "interested in private deployment + benchmarking". Matched routing rule prototype -> solutions-eng.

Lena: Perfect. Next steps: Ben to drop copy, Kai to finalize competitor table trims, Priya to lock the 3 core contrasts, Marta to draft rep rebuttal bullets. We'll reconvene for a 15m dry run tomorrow 10:30am PT. :spiral_calendar:

Marta: 10:30 works for me.

Priya: +1

Kai: See you then.

Ben: On it.
